_doc: Cards for /achievements/. An id that matches content/site.json achievements.highlights or more_results takes its year, title, detail, sources and confidence from there; any other entry carries them itself. Only confirmed/owner entries render. A card shows a photo only if photo_source says why it shows that athlete or event; otherwise it renders as a typographic card.
